integrity: Analytic proof with Jacobi identities and a cited unweighted theorem; bounded independent computation corroborates and does not establish the infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Coefficientwise congruence and prime-valuation sufficient criterion only; no classification of all zero residues or higher 2-adic congruences. Published unweighted 4-regular congruences are cited, not claimed. Unindexed equivalent work remains a possibility.
title: A quadratic-form transfer modulo eight for partitions with distinct even parts
